entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order I received a couple of weeks ago, the VeloBand Pulse HR monitor.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Alex. I have your order right here. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 15th. What seems to be the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's definitely a preference thing. To be honest, I've just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy for my new year's resolution, and I find that I just don't use it.
I see. I appreciate the honesty. Let me just pull up the return eligibility for your order. One moment.

Thanks. I know I'm probably outside the standard window. I think I saw something about 10 days for these new devices. But since it's barely been used, I was hoping we could work something out. I'd even take a partial store credit. I was about to look into a resale marketplace, but I'd rather work with VeloFit directly if possible.

No, that won't be necessary at all, Alex. I'm looking at the policy right here, and your purchase is eligible for a return within 90 days of delivery. You're only on day 19, so you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh, really? 90 days? That's fantastic! I must have misread the website. That's a huge relief.

Not a problem, I'm happy to clarify that for you. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you a prepaid return shipping label to the email we have on file. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll process your full refund back to the original payment method.
Wow, that was incredibly easy. Thank you so much for your help, David. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. You've been great.
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
